source.figure_table: CLIMB SCD-121 pivotal trial — efficacy endpoint (severe VOC) tables

context.genotype: severe SCD (HbSS per trial inclusion: severe SCD; ages 12–35)

observation.assay: Freedom from severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 consecutive months (broad severe-VOC endpoint: any medical facility visit of any duration, any cause; per the endpoint reanalysis, Frangoul et al. 2025)
observation.unit: patients free from severe VOCs ≥12 consecutive months
observation.uncertainty: Wilson 95% CI [0.833, 0.994]; published aggregate — not an efficacy estimate
observation.evidence_locator: NEJM 390(18):1649–1662; PMID 38661449; efficacy endpoint; data cut 14 Jun 2023 (CLIMB SCD-121)

note: Published totals from the pivotal trial: 29/30 evaluable (44 participants infused). Reproduced by the endpoint reanalysis: 29/30 (96.7%; 95% CI 82.8–99.9) under the broad severe-VOC definition. See ai-science-lab/outputs/scd-published-endpoint.json.
